::: {#exm-spanning-tree}
#### A spanning tree of the town graph

Let $W$ be the graph of @fig-hub, the *town graph*.
The six roads of @sol-fewest-roads, with all seven towns, form a spanning tree (@def-spanning-tree) $S$ of $W$, drawn thick in @fig-hub-spanning.
$S$ is connected, by @sol-fewest-roads.
It has no cycles, by @lem-degree-one:
in $S$, take out $a$, $d$ and $f$, which have degree 1,
then $b$, then $c$, then $g$, and $e$ is left with no edges.

::: {#fig-hub-spanning}
